# Version 1.13.1

## Changes
- Reverted back to Minecraft's default credits.
    - Developer note, from Dillon: After re-reading through default Minecraft credits, I believe that the story it tells ultimately points to Jesus. Towards the end, it speaks of the universe showing infinite care and love for the player, which is exactly what God does. I have made this change because I think this story is much deeper and passionate than the one that I wrote. Finally, to the person that commented on this mod, stating that my credits were proselytizing, I apologize, but I do hope you see the story of God and his love through Minecraft's credits. Check the bottom of the changelog for a deeper visual of what I see. :)
- Tweaked splash texts.
- Added a "Resource Packs" button to the resources screen, which includes a resource pack template for the speedrunner mod, as well as a "dark mode" pack.
- Optimized the Resources screen & Other Mods screen.

## Bugs Fixed
- The end podium generates at the bottom of the end on doom mode.
- Workbench error texture is squished.
- Tons of flint and steels can generate in nether fortress chests.
- Ender matter almost always drops when killing enderman.
  - In addition to this bug fix, ender matter now has a 27% chance of dropping when killing enderman, with a 3% increase for each level of looting.

## The Ending of Minecraft's credits reflect God's infinite love.
"You. You. You are alive.

Sometimes the player believed the universe *(God)* had spoken to it through the sunlight that came through the shuffling leaves of the summer trees

And sometimes the player believed the universe *(God)* had spoken to it through the light that fell from the crisp night sky of winter, where a fleck of light in the corner of the player's eye might be a star a million times as massive as the sun, boiling its planets to plasma in order to be visible for a moment to the player, walking home at the far side of the universe, suddenly smelling food, almost at the familiar door, about to dream again

And sometimes the player believed the universe *(God)* had spoken to it through the zeros and ones, through the electricity of the world, through the scrolling words on a screen at the end of a dream

And the universe *(God)* said I love you *(Isaiah 43:4)*

And the universe *(God)* said you have played the game well *(Matthew 25:21, in the end days)*

And the universe *(God)* said everything you need is within you *(Romans 8:9, Romans 8:11, 2 Timothy 1:14, John 14:17)*

And the universe *(God)* said you are stronger than you know *(2 Corinthians 12:9, Philippians 4:13, Isaiah 40:29)*

And the universe *(God)* said you are the daylight *(Matthew 5:14)*

And the universe *(God)* said you are the night *(Ephesians 5:8)*

And the universe *(God)* said the light you seek is within you *(John 8:12)*

And the universe *(God)* said you are not alone *(Deuteronomy 31:6, Isaiah 41:10, Psalm 23:4, Joshua 1:9)*

And the universe *(God)* said you are not separate from every other thing *(Romans 8:38-39)*

And the universe *(God)* said you are the universe tasting itself, talking to itself, reading its own code *(Psalm 119:105)*

And the universe *(God)* said I love you because you are love. *(1 John 4:16)*

And the game was over and the player woke up from the dream. And the player began a new dream. And the player dreamed again, dreamed better. And the player was the universe. And the player was love. *(Isaiah 43:19, Proverbs 3:5-6, Psalm 37:5)*

You are the player.

Wake up."

# Version 1.13
- Update to 26.3.

## Mod now requires [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) in order to run!
### Requires [Fabric Loader version 0.19.5](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) *and* [Fabric API version 0.160.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) or greater.
### Requires [DillonLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/dillon-lib) version 1.1 or greater.

## Removed Features
- The Speedrunner Paddle has been removed from the mod, and all fireproof boat items have also been removed. Speedrunner, warped and crimson boats are now immune to lava with the default boat crafting recipe with planks.
    - You no longer need a speedrunner paddle to make them fireproof.
    - The Dead Speedrunner Boat is still vulnerable to fire.
- All Dead Speedrunner Blocks and items can be smelted in regular Speedrunner blocks/items.
- Speedrunner ingots, nuggets and blocks can no longer be used to craft some vanilla items.
- Due to redundancy, all stripped speedrunner logs have been removed from the mod.
- Rotten Speedrunner Bulk has been removed.

## Loot and Worldgen
- The mod's Structure Spawn Rate option is now a simple toggle switch, which has been renamed to the legacy "Make Structures More Common" option, and custom structure spawn rates are only possible via the config (and if Make Structures More Common option is enabled).
- Certain structure spawn rates have been modified.
- Abandoned camps generate more commonly.
- More mobs now drop more loot, and modified some existing buffed loot tables, including piglin bartering and abandoned camps.
- Buffed additional loot tables, including archaeology, fishing, and other vanilla loot containers.
- Underwater ruins will now always contain a golden speedrunner helmets and a buried treasure map.
- Ender matter can now be obtained via fishing in a deep cold ocean biome, archeology, and from trial chambers.
- Experience fragments can now be obtained via fishing, archeology, trial chambers and trial chambers.
- Inventory preservers can be found in other various places.
- Various mob spawning changes, and removed "Creature Spawn Rate" option.

## Fireball Changes
- The default fireball explosion power has been reverted to 1.
- On doom mode, zombies now only throw 1-2 explosion power fireballs, and the power is not increased based on the fireball explosion power option.
- Any sort of fireball is now considered a speedrunner imperative entity.

## Revamps and Other Changes
- The mod's built-in "fog" option is now disabled by default (meaning Minecraft's fog will be disabled by default).
- Tweaked how long certain speedrunner items last in a furnace as fuel.
- Doom blocks now function the same on easy and balanced mode as they do on doom mode.
- New number providers (floats and integers).
- Finally wiped the leaderboards from the mod entirely.
- Removed the mod's safe boot screen and links screen.
- Removed stronghold configuration options.
- Revamped speedrunner mod screens.

## Technical Changes
- Massive backend optimizations, and several changes to the mod's configuration system.
- Several tag removals for conventional item tag replacements.
- Removed "minBrightness" option.

## Bugs Fixed
- You can combine enchantments in a speedrunners workbench to go over level 10.

releases.notes:
# Version 1.12.2 (Fabric 26.1.2)

# The Speedrunner Spear
- A new `spear`, which has a `reach distance` of `5.5 blocks` (1 block longer than normal spears with a 4.5 block reach)
    - Has a `7 block reach in creative mode.`
    - Falls right in the middle of `iron` and `diamond` spears, in terms of item durability and damage.
- Additionally, the speedrunner spear gives `increased momemtum` from the `lunge` enchantment.
- Crafted like `any normal spear`, with a `speedrunner ingot`.
- Can be found natrually in `village weaponsmith chests` and `buried treasure chests`.

# The Golden Speedrunner Spear
- Similar to the `speedrunner spear,` the `golden speedrunner spear` has a `reach distance` of `6 blocks`, and a creative reach of `7 blocks.`
  - Similar durability of `golden speedrunner tools`.
- This also gives even more `increased momemtum` from the `lunge` enchantment.
- Crafted with a `golden smithing upgrade template` from a `golden spear` (and a speedrunner ingot).
- Can be found in `bastion treasure chests.`

## Retired Speedrunner Changes
- Retired speedrunners now sell `ominous bottles` in place of the `withered enchantment.`

## Dragons Aura Changes
- When using the `dragon's aura effect` to save the player from the void, the effect will be removed after `30 seconds.`
  - Additionally, the player will receive a `message` about their `dragon's aura status.`

## Inventory Preserver Changes
- New, `brighter` texture for the `inventory preserver!`

## Goliath Changes
- Renamed the `"Goliath"` advancement to `"David and Goliath"`.
- Shooting at `Goliath` when he is at `half health` will now `heal him` based on how much health he has.
  - The less health he has, `the more he can heal from the arrow.`
- Attempting to hit `Goliath` with any `spear` (including speedrunner spears) will drastically `damage the player`.

## Feature Screens
- Removed the built-in `feature screens`. A `wiki page` is soon coming for the mod.
  - The `"first time playing"` screen and `"secret doom mode"` screens `still remain.`

## Other Changes
- Doom block loot is now an `actual loot table.`
  - Tweaked the `loot` that you can get from doom blocks.
  - Additionally, doom blocks now have a `22-32%` chance to drop loot for `each time` that you break it (previously a `flat 10%`).
- Buffed `ominous trial chamber loot` even more.
- Renamed the `"Speedrunner Mod"` item group to `"The Speedrunner Mod"`.
- Updated `"Playing Mode"` debug entry to `"Mode".`
- Tweaked lang files and tooltip translations.

## Bugs Fixed
- Fixed bug where using a speedrunner's workbench to upgrade a golden tool to a speedrunner tool triggers the "One Step Ahead" advancement.
- Fixed bug where faster smelting does not fully work.
- Fixed other random bugs.

releases.notes:
# Version 1.12 (Fabric 26.1.2)

- `Updated to 26.1.2!`
- The mod now requires `Fabric Loader version 0.19.2 to run.`

## Worldgen Changes
- `Speedrunner blocks` now have a small chance to generate within patches of `raw speedrunner blocks` in the `Speedrunner's Wasteland biome.`

## Dragon's Aura Changes
- Lowered the default dragon's aura duration to `2 minutes` (previously 4).
- Lowered the increased duration of the dragon's aura to `6 minutes` (previously 8).

## Retired Speedrunner Changes
- Retired speedrunner trades are now `data-driven.`
- Tweaked `retired speedrunner trades.`
  - Retired speedrunners `now sell potions` instead of tipped arrows.
  - Retired speedrunners can `now sell emeralds for 3 speedrunner ingots.`
  - Retired speedrunners `no longer sell max level enchanted books.` `Levels are now random.`

## Doom Mode Changes
- Reverted back to the `default doom trees.`
- Reverted back to `default Goliath sounds` (low-pitched zombie sounds).
  - Dillon note: I sounded stupid making those sounds lol
- `Goliath` no longer needs to `see a player` in order `to target it.`

## Other Changes
- Removed the `"Better Villager Trades"` option.
- `Fireproof boats now float a little higher in lava.`
- New splash texts.
- Added `Discord link` for `Mod menu.`
- Updated compatibility for [Quality of Queso](https://modrinth.com/mod/quality-of-queso) and [Simple Keybinds](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-keybinds).
- Removed `tutorial mode feature images.`

### Technical Additions
- New item tags: `retired_speedrunner_potions`, and `retired_speedrunner_level_#`
  - Retired speedrunner potions are potions that can be sold by retired speedrunner's (*not* including dragon's aura, as that is a separate trade)
  - Retired speedrunner level **#** are level tags that contain each trade that a retired speedrunner can offer at their profession level.
- Updated initialization success message.
- Renamed `mixin options,` according to Minecraft's official mappings.
- Removed `"RenderLayersMixin"`, because it has been removed, and is not needed anymore.

## Bugs Fixed
- Fixed (rare) critical crash with mixins.

releases.notes:
Version 1.12 (Fabric 1.21.11)
# DRAGON'S AURA POTION
- Added a new status effect, called "Dragons Aura", which gives the player +5 hearts, deals x2 more damage, added armor points and toughness, and increased block interaction distance.
- Any entity that has the Dragon's Aura effect takes 50% less damage from the ender dragon, and will also admit portal particles around themselves.
- Players are immune to dragon breath attacks with this effect, and also immune to fall damage.

- Players are also immune to ender pearl damage with this effect.
- Players will not receive blindness on doom mode when throwing an ender pearl with this effect.
- All players' armor will have a 45% chance to ignore all durability damage per hit with this effect applied.

- Enderman do not get angry at players if they look at them if they have this effect.

- To craft the Dragon's Aura potion, you will need water bottles and ender matter.
- When brewed, the potion's duration is 4 minutes. You can extend it to 8 minutes with redstone.
- You cannot increase this potion's amplifier.

- Dragon's Aura potions can also be found in end city chests and from trading with Retired Speedrunners.

- If the player dies with this effect, their death sound effect is changed to the ender dragon hurting.
- If the player falls into the void with this effect, they will be levitated up extremely fast to have a chance at surviving the void. This only happens once, and the player can only do it again if they died and re-applied the effect.
- You can also obtain the "Immortal" advancement by doing this.

- Breaking doom blocks with this effect will not spawn the bad mobs.

- Credit to MannyQUESO for creating the texture for the effect icon.

- Yes, there is an advancement for obtaining this potion, called "Dragon's Aura."

- This potion has been specifically designed for doom mode (it works on all modes), to make the end fight actually possible.

# INVENTORY PRESERVER
- A new item, called the "Inventory Preserver", which keeps your inventory upon death!
- It has 1 durability point, so 1 single use per item.
- They can only be found in bastion chests, ancient city chests, and very rarely in stronghold chests.
- You can combine it with ender matter to increase it's max durability all the way up to 3. It cannot be repaired, nor can you add unbreaking or mending to it.
- Good for doom mode!

# WITHERED ENCHANTMENT
- A new enchantment, called "Withered", which inflicts any entity you hit with the wither effect.
- For each level, the wither's effect is longer. At level 4, you can inflict wither 2, and level 5 inflicts wither 3.
- Using this enchantment on wither skeletons increases the chance of skulls dropping (minimum is 13% chance, can go all the way up to 65% with level 5).
- Looting no longer works to increase chance of wither skeleton skulls, you must use the "Withered" enchantment to increase chance.

- The withered enchantment can be found in nether fortress chests, and from the Retired Speedrunner.

- With this, the wither sword and wither bones have been removed from the mod and replaced with this.

# SPEEDRUNNERS WORKBENCH CHANGES
- You can now add a Golden Upgrade Smithing Template to the workbench to remove all durability damage. Doing this will result in double the cost.
- You can now transfer enchantments directly to books.
- The workbench is now crafted with 5 speedrunner planks, a speedrunner block, and 3 speedrunner ingots.
- Renamed "Golden Speedrunner Upgrade Smithing Template" to "Golden Upgrade Smithing Template", as the name was way too long, and rendered off the screen.
- You can now upgrade golden tools to golden speedrunner tools in the speedrunner's workbench.

# DRAGON'S FIREBALL
- Yup, you guessed it. The dragon's fireball, as a throwable item.
- When thrown, it does exactly what the ender dragon's fireball does. Except, it's effect last longer, and it creates an explosion upon impact.

releases.notes:
KEY CHANGES:
- A new credits story. I recommend reading it once you complete a speedrun with this mod.
- Splash texts are back!
- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.5!
- Tons of bug fixes, crash fixes, and optimizations.
- Renamed "Playing Mode" option to "Mode".
- Optimized options and changed configuration file layout.
- To change an option's value in the configuration file, change the "current_value". Leave everything else alone.
- Hold down "shift" on an options screen to open the client-side configuration file.

CRASH FIXES:
- Fixed server crash with Terraform Wood API (this mod no longer depends on Terraform Wood API).
- Split client and common sources. Client-sided options are now strictly client-side and do not interfere with the server side. Same with server-side options, they do not interfere with the client-side.

TUTORIAL MODE:
- Tutorial mode is now client-side only, meaning multiple players can work at their own pace and progress on their own.
- Tutorial mode now works correctly on servers.
- Tutorial mode is no longer a beta feature, it's official.
- Optimized and fixed bugs in tutorial mode.

SPEEDRUNNER BOAT CHANGES:
- New item! - Speedrunner paddle: used to paddle the speedrunner boat. Crafted with a speedrunner block, speedrunner ingot, and a speedrunner stick.
- Normal speedrunner boats are now crafted with 5 speedrunner planks, a lava bucket and 2 speedrunner paddles.

SPEEDRUNNER's WORKBENCH:
- The Speedrunner's Workbench is now crafted with 3 speedrunner planks, a speedrunner block, a speedrunner paddle, ANY speedrunner tool, and 3 speedrunner ingots.
- Transferring enchantments via the speedrunner's workbench will now damage the output based on each enchantment's transferred level.
- You can no longer use enchanted books with the speedrunner's workbench.

REMOVALS:
- Removed the button and keybind (R) to "refresh" a screen (refreshing screen is never needed now because the bug where buttons don't display correctly is fixed).
- Removed custom panorama option.
- Removed confirmation messages option.
- Removed item tooltips and texture tooltips option.
- Deleted place on Dillon8775's webpage, everything you would need for this mod is now on CurseForge and Modrinth.

MISCELLANEOUS
- Removed "DISABLED" structure spawn rate option, now set to "Default" to use Minecraft's default structure spawn rates.
- You can now use the Ender Thruster on doom mode if the player is in a mountain/hill biome, or if the player's Y-level is less than 0.
- Changing the "allow cheats" option in the fast world creation screen will enable/disable cheats in your current world.
- Experiences ores now generate on every mode.
- Added option to sync client-side options with server-side options, to allow for optimal gameplay.

releases.notes:
- Removed State-of-the-Art items option (see more info below).
- Removed Doom Mode option, replaced with new option, Playing Mode:
- There are three levels to the Playing Mode: Easy, Normal, and Doom. Easy is the default option.
Easy Mode
- Enables state-of-the-art items/features (eye of annul teleportation feature, blaze spotter, dragons pearl, etc.)
- Makes certain structures smaller for easier navigation.
- Makes certain ores generate more commonly.
- Makes experience orbs generate throughout the world.
- Makes ender eyes have a higher chance of generating pre-filled in the stronghold.
Normal Mode
- Disables state-of-the-art items/features (items like the dragons pearl and eye of annul teleportation feature will not work on this playing mode).
Doom Mode
- It's just doom mode, but in a different setting. For more info on Doom Mode, refer to the [features page.](https://sites.google.com/view/dillon8775/the-speedrunner-mod?authuser=0#h.vrpwt7r96krx)
- This option was added to balance the mod, and give players the option to play as a very beginner speedrunner, or to just speedrun with only a few changes to the game, instead of basically playing on a "baby mode".

- Removed golden food items (steak, porkchop, etc.).

World Generation Changes
- Nether fortresses and bastions are now slightly more rare to make the eye of inferno more useful.

"Eye-Item" Changes
- The Eye of Annul no longer locates the exact distance of the stronghold, it is now the eye of ender that does this.
- The Eye of Ender behaves normally, with the addition of sending the exact distance of the nearest stronghold (in blocks) to the player.
- The Eye of Annul is now only used for teleporting directly to the stronghold portal room.
- The Eye of Annul now requires an ender eye to craft.
- The Speedrunner's Eye and Eye of Inferno now have a custom data component, called "locating_structure", which stores what structure that the item is currently locating.
- Speedrunner's Eyes now only stack to 16.
- Throwing a disabled item (ex. on playing mode Normal mode or Doom Mode) will consume the item, but give the resources to craft it back to the player.

Speedrunner Workbench Changes
- The Speedrunner's Workbench now has it's own functioning user-interface screen, instead of manually having to hold the items to transfer enchantments.
- Fixed bugs with level cost calculations.
- Level cost for transferring enchantments is now based on the total amount of enchantments transferred + each enchantment level.
cost = (total amount of enchantments transferred + every enchantment's transferred level).

The Speedrunner's Totem!
- The Speedrunner's Totem works anywhere in the player's inventory.
- Stacks to 3.
- Gives regeneration II for 1.5 minutes, absorption II for 1 minute, resistance, and speed for 30 seconds, strength for 15 seconds, slow falling for 10 seconds, and fire resistance for 2 minutes upon use.
- The Speedrunner's Totem will also work if the player falls into the void, anywhere in the inventory. However, a normal totem will only work if it is equipped in the player's offhand or mainhand.
- Crafting recipe: totem of undying, and ender matter.

Knockback Stick item
- Has 10 durability points.
- Comes with Knockback V.
- Can only be obtained via Doom Mode.

Flesh Block
- Crafted with 9 pieces of rotten flesh and/or cooked flesh.
- Has a slipperiness effect.

Giant? It's Goliath.
- Renamed the Giant boss to Goliath.
- Goliath is now no longer doom mode exclusive.
- He can still only be found naturally in doom mode, but, you can summon him anywhere with 2 flesh blocks and a zombie head.
- Other optimizations to Goliath.

Fireball Changes
- Throwing a fireball now shows the correct animation.
- You can also shift-right click on a block and still throw a fireball.
- Increased default fireball explosion power amount from 1 to 2.
